notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Beasts![/h1]

How are you doing, everyone? We hope you had an amazing time lately, so we encourage you to go for a walk to the forest! But seriously, are you excited for [i]Mythic: Forest Warden[/i] as much as we are? Let’s get to the cool updates we got!

[h2]Hiding System + Tunnels[/h2]

That right here - is such an interesting feature I still can’t get my head around it. Just imagine setting a trap for enemy soldiers… you can sneak into the forest litter, like those below:
Spots you can sneak into are highlighted in yellow in the Beast Mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41215738/24993727431bcf73c138c1c76b1c796f061e58fb.png[/img]

When you are inside you can freely move between them, highlighted triangle will let you know you can do so, check the image below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41215738/1efdebe4c42b4c628e7aac406f25175fe59b73a7.jpg[/img]

That’s pretty neat! We are going to improve this system, as it is one of the fundamental mechanics of the game, as well as using trees to your advantage.

[h2]Branch Walking System[/h2]

Another fundamental system in our game is the branch walking system. It allows the player to move around the world and have the high ground. It’s very important for us to make it as enjoyable as we can. We mentioned this system in our previous devlog, but we made significant progress in that field.

So, the trees that will allow you to move freely on them are highlighted in red, in the Beast Mode, as seen in image below - those are the branches you can jump onto.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41215738/512e2da21f88c7ad0861eef7ff5901b293a32387.png[/img]

When you jump on one, you have a lot of new possibilities!
You have the ability to move freely on them, jump between different branches (marker is seen on image below) to gain more advantage in the game - or you can jump between different trees that are nearby!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41215738/9f29a117027357c5d20bc66fc82621b8f690d9bd.png[/img]

Those features are very exciting, developing them is even more fun!

Take care, Beasts, take a walk to the nearest forest, get some fresh air and meet some mythical creatures! See you next time!

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
[b]Hello, Beasts![/b]

Today we're dropping in to let you know of a few things we are currently working on in [i]Mythic: Forest Warden![/i]

Before we do, we would like to thank those who wishlisted our games on Steam! We are very happy that you are interested in our ideas and work, and we promise to deliver the best gaming experience we can!

[h2]Beast Mode[/h2]
This is an exciting feature and we think you'll agree with us - as a mythical beast, a god, you will have an ability to use the "Beast Mode". It will allow you to check your surroundings in more detail. Currently this mode highlights things like enemies and their weapons, consumables, branches to walk and mana trees.
Below you can see a comparison between the default perspective, and the beast mode (red light around camera):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41215738/0da8bcc98ae71c36c7e3836b96e9f7f43dfa8ab2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41215738/44dcc1fcf98be97b3df41b437767ce03956657c1.png[/img]

[h2]
Branch walking[/h2]
Being a forest god comes with a lot of fascinating things. We are currently working on a prototype mechanic to allow players jump on a branch to check your surroundings more clearly or perform a jump down kill!
Branches that will allow you to do such things will be highlighted in Beast Mode, so be sure to look around and use your surroundings - this is your main advantage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41215738/54394ae9e87c6250c468816f6954ae93dd233883.png[/img]

We still have a lot of things to do, so we're getting back to work!
Have an amazing day, Beasts, and see you soon in the forest!
